visualCharacteristics.purpose: Columns of navigational link lists (support links, product directories, sitemap) with optional icon headings

contentPattern.structure: optional first single-cell intro row (heading + text); then one row with 2-3 cells, each holding an optional icon + heading and a list (or run of paragraphs) of links. Nested lists render as bulleted sub-links. A cell holding only a link to a /fragments/ path is replaced by that fragment, for long sitemap columns
cells: link column (optional icon, heading, link list)

usage: Extra help and support link lists (27 pages), 'Explore our products' directories, the sitemap page.
reuseGuidance: Use for columns whose main content is lists of links. `image` adds an icon beside each column heading with leading chevrons; `grey` is the same structure on a grey section (sitemap). Use columns-contact for contact details and cards-feature for cards.
